authority_rule: The original published study is the only source of truth. Every claim scored must trace to one of this study's primary_sources, with a page, table or figure reference. If a finding in this registry is not supported by the source, mark it not_testable with reason claim_not_in_any_source and say so; the registry can be wrong, the study cannot.

primary_sources.cite: Dungan & Chang, Proc R Soc B 2017, doi:10.1098/rspb.2016.2743

replication_targets.finding: Site 83 has a significant effect on the measured phenotype, and its effect differs between species backgrounds (significant species-by-site interaction).
replication_targets.source: Dungan & Chang 2017 supplement, Supplementary Table 1 two-way ANOVA
replication_targets.test: This is a genuine published epistasis result. Does epistaeon detect site 83 as background-dependent?

replication_targets.finding: Sites 83, 292 and 299 are the assayed positions.

structures.notes: Bovine, dark-state 11-cis retinal, 348 residues complete, numbering equal to UniProt and to human rhodopsin. Ala292 and Gly121 are 3.3 A and 3.7 A from retinal and 10.3 A apart. Dark state only: any claim about transducin coupling needs an active-state structure, which is not in the repo.

known_limitations: Retinal release after photoactivation is not a direct dark-noise rate. Do not treat it as one.
Teleosts are absent from the mammal-only alignment, as is Rhinolophus unihastatus. Cetaceans (75) and bats (113) are well represented.
The Yokoyama ancestral-rhodopsin supplement could not be obtained, so only the Dungan & Chang material is available locally.
expected_outcome_note: RH1 is the best epistasis ground truth in the local materials: a published, statistically tested species-by-site interaction. Weight it heavily.
